advance_only_if: each dataset selected minus PCA mAP@R >= -0.003
each dataset selected minus PCA Recall@1 >= -0.003
decision.failure: close the cross-fitted second-order selector lane without outer evaluation

family: normalize(P^T (W + lambda * trace(W)/768 I)^(-alpha) (x - mean)); P is top-128 PCA after the power transform
folds: sort fit classes by SHA256(power-whitening-v1:<dataset>:<label>), train on alternating classes and validate on the complement in both directions

grid.rule: alpha zero occurs once because lambda is then inert; otherwise full Cartesian product; select by descending pooled mAP@R, Recall@1, then cell key

prohibitions: no evaluation feature or label access
no outer evaluation after a failed fit-only screen
do not describe the grid selector as a new representation
storage: float screen; quantize only a selected cell after the fit-only gate because prior evidence found negligible quantization loss
